description: MUST-FAIL: unsafe integer (2^53) inside an array. jcs-n forbids integers |n| >= 2^53 because they cannot be exactly represented in IEEE 754 double; an implementation MUST reject them even when nested in arrays. Regression vector for the array-bypass bug (Fix 1, round 2).
note: 9007199254740992 = 2^53, the first integer not exactly representable as an IEEE 754 double. An implementation that delegates arrays to json.dumps will silently serialize it, producing a non-interoperable digest.
